description: 203.0.113.50 SYN-scans ports 1-1000 of 192.0.2.10 in about 3s, common ports first; 22, 80 and 443 answer SYN/ACK and are reset by the scanner (half-open), the rest refuse. port_scan fires once, lists the open ports, then summarizes. 1000 incomplete handshakes over 1000 ports is not a SYN flood. The SYN to 853 also fires the low-severity DoT policy rule once.
